task.title: Finally verify consent-to-dashboard analytics and statistical day boundaries
task.input: analytics-ingest/aggregate/retention, real product events and final stats-ui
task.output: analytics-acceptance: real ingestion/aggregation, time-zone and retention-authorization evidence
task.accept: 1) Use the real consent control, actual page/product visits and GLB start/one terminal, a scheduled committed aggregate and /admin/stats reads tied to the same productSlug/viewId. Refusal/withdrawal prevents collection. Success rate uses only consented starts; actual failure/timeout is not success; no samples gives null and mean duration includes samples (E-42, E-61, E-63). 2) Dedicated PostgreSQL plus HTTP tests cover 23/25-hour DST days, midnight, 48-hour lateness, same-revision snapshots and refusal of an old lease committing late. A time-zone change cannot stitch trends beyond raw coverage. Raw-30-day/aggregate-13-month candidate boundaries are testable; without explicit production retention authorization, an actual-cleanup request is refused with zero deletions (E-48, E-56, E-81, E-88).
